label: Takeaway
detail: As played, Rochester Christian went 20-27 and 13-15 in the WHAC, and its 3-1 series win over Defiance on Apr 24-25 clinched a first WHAC Tournament spot. RCU's schedule lists 8-39 and 4-24, because 31 games were later marked as forfeits for an ineligible player, and RCU withdrew before the tournament. No 2027 roster is posted; by class, players who can return had 55% of 2026 plate appearances and 80% of innings.

label: Method
detail: No 2027 roster is posted. Back means a 2026 player listed as a freshman, sophomore or junior. Listed seniors count as gone. A class listing doesn't confirm who returns.

label: Season
detail: 20-27 as played followed 14-29 in 2025, counting two fall wins over Miami-Middletown on Oct 11, 2025, which RCU's season totals include; the spring was 18-27. RCU scored 264 runs and allowed 404, hit .248 with 26 homers and posted an 8.78 ERA, per its official stats. As played it went 8-9 in games listed as home, 11-15 away and 1-3 at neutral sites.

label: Postseason
detail: RCU's Apr 25 release says the series win over Defiance clinched its first WHAC Tournament appearance. RCU then withdrew from the tournament over the ineligible player, and Siena Heights, Lawrence Tech and Cornerstone moved into the last three seeds.

label: lu_proj
detail: Built from 2026 box scores, using only players who can return by class. Each spot goes to the returner with the most 2026 starts there. Order is by 2026 OPS, so small samples rank high. Set means 20 or more starts at the spot, Likely 8 or more.

label: lu_most
detail: A typical 2026 lineup, built from all 47 box scores. Each position goes to the player with the most starts there, using each player once and keeping as many of those starts as possible; the DH spot counts only starts at DH. The order is each player's average spot across all his 2026 starts, lowest first. No one started half the games at DH (Shakotko, 13), so those spots were shared. 2027 outlook is the same status used on the rest of this page.

label: lu_all
detail: RCU used 43 different lineups in 47 games. A lineup counts as the same only with the same nine in the same order at the same positions.

label: rot_proj
detail: The same 2026 stats, with projected 2027 roles for pitchers who can return by class. Listed seniors made 10 of the 46 starts on player lines, led by Shafer's 9.

label: Staff
detail: Main starters made at least 4 starts. Relievers made at least 5 relief outings and aren't main starters. GS and Relief are published totals.

label: Maps
detail: 31 of the 33 players with a listed hometown are from Michigan, 9 of them from Macomb County and 7 from Oakland County. The others list Kouts, Ind., and Vega Alta, P.R.

label: League
detail: Using RCU's official totals, it would rank 8th of 12 WHAC teams in OPS (.755) and 7th in runs per game (5.62). On the mound it would rank 8th in ERA (8.78) and 5th in strikeouts per nine (8.20).

label: Method
detail: wOBA uses standard big-league weights. FIP uses a constant that sets the NAIA-wide FIP equal to NAIA ERA. Rank 1 is best in every row. RCU isn't on NAIA stats, so its column uses its own official totals, which include the two fall games, ranked against the 11 WHAC and 179 NAIA teams NAIA stats lists. Its ranks are out of 12 and 180.

label: Filter
detail: All games shows RCU's published totals. Any other filter is added up from box scores and play-by-play, game by game. The filter changes the Hitters, Pitchers and Tendencies tabs. Player cards always show the full season.

label: Outing log
detail: Days of rest counts full calendar days since the pitcher's previous appearance, whatever the filter. Pitch counts show a dash when a box score lists none.

label: Aiden Alspaugh
detail: Alspaugh, a listed senior catcher, hit .327 with a 1.019 OPS, 6 homers and a team-high 41 RBI. He was second-team All-WHAC for a second straight year, per RCU, and made the WHAC Gold Glove team.

label: Matthew Redmond
detail: Redmond, a sophomore, went 5-3 with a 3.79 ERA and 61 strikeouts in 61.2 innings, and opponents hit .251. He was second-team All-WHAC and can return by class. Lance Jones, also a sophomore, went 5-1 with a 4.97 ERA and 61 strikeouts in 54.1 innings.

label: Scoring
detail: RCU scored 5.62 runs a game and hit 26 homers; Alspaugh, Shafer and Falkenhagen had 6 each. Its .368 on-base percentage came with 210 walks and 56 hit by pitches. Vega led with 24 steals, and the team stole 83 in 103 tries.

label: League play
detail: As played, RCU went 13-15 in the WHAC, was outscored 160-248 and hit .244 with an 8.39 ERA in those 28 games. It swept Lawrence Tech and Siena Heights on the road, split with Madonna, Michigan-Dearborn, Cornerstone and Lourdes, won three of four from Defiance, and lost both games to Cleary, Aquinas, Indiana Tech and Northwestern Ohio.

label: Close games
detail: RCU went 5-3 in one-run games as played. The Apr 11 second game at Siena Heights went 14 innings; RCU won it 5-4.

label: Senior losses
detail: Listed seniors had 724 of 1611 plate appearances on player lines, led by Alspaugh, Shafer and Falkenhagen, and 67.2 of 340.1 innings, led by Shafer (35.0).

detail: His bio says he is in his sixth year on the staff, works mainly with pitchers and was a closer at Mott CC and RCU.

label: Where the roster comes from
detail: 31 of 33 list a Michigan hometown, 9 in Macomb County and 7 in Oakland County. One lists Kouts, Ind., and one Vega Alta, P.R.

label: How players arrive
detail: From the roster's Hometown/Previous School column, which lists one school: 15 of 33 list a high school, 13 a two-year college (St. Clair County CC 3, Mid-Michigan CC 2, Jackson CC 2, Schoolcraft CC 2, Detroit Christian CC 2, Henry Ford CC 1, Macomb CC 1) and 5 a four-year school (Cornerstone, Dillard, Madonna, Spring Arbor, Trine).

label: Forfeits recorded as played
detail: RCU's schedule marks 31 games Forfeit because an ineligible player took part. Every record, score and line here uses the game as played, from the box score. Twelve of those games were RCU wins on the field and are listed as 7-0 or 9-0 losses: Feb 21 Kentucky Christian (Ky.) 8-4; Feb 28 Ohio Christian (Ohio) 14-10; Mar 10 IU Columbus (Ind.) 7-6; Mar 14 Lourdes 4-0; Mar 21 Cornerstone 13-11; Mar 30 Michigan-Dearborn 9-1; Apr 6 Madonna 5-2; Apr 6 Madonna 3-1; Apr 11 Siena Heights 8-0; Apr 11 Siena Heights 5-4; Apr 18 Lawrence Tech 7-0; Apr 18 Lawrence Tech 8-3. In one more, the Apr 21 loss to Michigan-Dearborn, the 3-6 score on the field is listed as 0-7. The other 18 forfeit games were losses on the field and keep their scores. That is why the schedule shows 8-39 and 4-24 instead of 20-27 and 13-15.

label: A player line is missing from the totals
detail: In 30 box scores RCU lists one batter as "Team" instead of a name. Those lines count in the team totals but in no player's line, so the player lines fall short of the team totals by 27 at-bats, 6 hits, 23 runs and 12 steals, and by one start. Team rows use the official totals; player rows use the player lines.

label: Fall games count
detail: RCU's 2026 season totals include two fall games against Miami-Middletown on Oct 11, 2025, both wins. They're in every total here. One fall player, Drew Schultz, isn't on the spring roster or the published lines.

label: A save placed by the box score
detail: Wagner's one save isn't marked in any box score. The Apr 18 8-3 win at Lawrence Tech is the only game he finished, entering with a one-run lead in the 8th, so the save is placed there. Every other published win, loss and save is in the box scores.

label: Some games have no real counts
detail: 12 of the 47 box scores have no usable counts, including both fall games, the Ohio Christian and Cincinnati-Clermont series and the Apr 11 and Apr 19 doubleheaders. Those games are left out of the count and pitch stats.

label: Home and away
detail: Home, away and neutral follow RCU's schedule listing. RCU played 11 games at Bill Shinsky Field in Rochester Hills and its other listed home games at Total Sports Complex in Wixom (Lourdes) and UWM Field in Utica (Indiana Tech and Northwestern Ohio). The four Kentucky Christian games in Campton, Ky., are neutral.

label: Roster
detail: The roster lists one previous school per player: a high school for players who came straight to RCU, a college for transfers.

label: Map sources
detail: Hometowns are from RCU's roster. I entered coordinates by hand, so towns are approximate. Shapes come from U.S. Census and Natural Earth.

label: Checked by arithmetic
detail: The box scores add to 20-27, 264 runs scored and 404 allowed, and to 13-15 in WHAC games, matching the win-loss record and run totals on RCU's official stats page.

label: Box scores are from RCU
detail: RCU isn't on NAIA stats, so all 47 box scores come from its own Presto site, captured Nov 7, 2026.

label: Box score gaps
detail: Box score totals are within a few of the official lines. The official lines have five more sacrifice flies, Wagner's save, and small hit-batter differences for Lance Jones, Rivera and Diserens. The Apr 8 play-by-play at Oakland doesn't record RCU's pitching changes, so in that game's pitch and tendency numbers every batter counts against the starter, Lance Jones; his box score line is right.

label: Projections
detail: Projected lineups and staffs come from public numbers and class. RCU has published no depth chart.

label: Commits
detail: No commit list for RCU was checked.

label: Spray charts are partial
detail: Spray charts use 914 of Rochester Christian's 1,334 at-bats (69%): 92% of balls in play, 80% of hits (264 of 330) and 98% of everything else (650 of 665). Strikeouts have no direction. Scorers skip the direction on hits far more often than on outs, so charts can understate hits. Zones are where the scorer placed the ball, not exact spots.

label: Direction corrected
detail: Double plays were being credited to the relay throw instead of the first fielder, and plays written with the last name first or an error by a fielder had no direction. I corrected that on Nov 4, which moved Pull, Center and Oppo a few points for some hitters and raised the direction counts.

label: Method
detail: With All games selected, every number in this view counts all 47 games, from box scores and play-by-play. Ground outs include sacrifices and fielder's choices, and air outs include sacrifice flies.

label: Partial
detail: Scorers didn't enter these details for every game, so each number covers only part of the season. Treat them as samples. The first two tables show what's missing.

label: Splits
detail: Innings and time through the order use every plate appearance. Time through the order is each pitcher's batters faced in that game divided by nine, so substitutions can shift it slightly.

label: Splits
detail: Only plate appearances with a count listed. The count is where the plate appearance stood before its final pitch. Two strikes and Full count overlap the other rows.

label: Ground and air outs
detail: Crane has 2.24 ground outs per air out, the most among regulars (90 or more plate appearances), and Kuzinski has 0.43.

label: How long arms go
detail: Redmond averages 5.9 innings a start, Lance Jones 4.8 and Shafer, a listed senior, 3.4.

label: Groundball and fly-ball arms
detail: Redmond has 1.49 ground outs per air out, the most among pitchers with 100 batters faced, and Jones has 0.53.

label: First-pitch swings
detail: Among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, Lahr swings at the most first pitches, 41% on 64. Vega swings at the fewest, 23% on 127.

label: Swing and miss
detail: Shakotko whiffs on 13% of swings, the fewest among regulars with pitch data on 60 or more plate appearances, and Falkenhagen on 39%.

label: Direction
detail: Kuzinski pulls 51% of his batted balls, the most among regulars, on 115 with a direction. Shakotko pulls 32%, on 63.

label: Pitch counts
detail: Redmond averages 91 pitches a start and Lance Jones 84. Redmond's most was 118. Averages use only outings with a listed count.
